checks.description: The generated Skill contains its entry point and core references.
checks.hint: Inspect generation readiness and reference planning before content quality.

checks.description: Every generated local Markdown link resolves inside the Skill.
checks.hint: Fix reference planning or relative link construction.

checks.description: An unchanged project produces an identical Skill tree on a repeated sync.
checks.hint: Inspect unstable timestamps, ordering, IDs, summaries, or non-deterministic projection logic.

checks.description: Source paths cited by generated references exist in the fixture project.
checks.hint: Verify AI locations against the source catalog before rendering.

checks.description: The exact interface ownership and identifier rules survive authority extraction and project-map refresh.
checks.hint: Review authoritative-section coverage and rule projection.

checks.description: Tenant and state-transition constraints remain explicit and scoped.
checks.hint: Ensure every authoritative section returns a linked rule receipt.

checks.description: Command authorization is visible from the entry Skill.
checks.hint: Project command policies should be routed from SKILL.md, not hidden in a deep reference.

checks.description: High-value reusable entries are indexed with complete usage contracts.
checks.hint: Improve capability selection and preserve semantic fields after symbol verification.

checks.description: The tenant-aware catalog entry remains discoverable.
checks.hint: Retain routeable module capabilities even when they are not top-level handlers.

checks.description: Generated handlers and type shells are not promoted as reusable capability entries.
checks.hint: Prefer canonical handwritten owners over generated transport shells.

checks.description: Order placement includes its ownership, orchestration, and failure boundary.
checks.hint: Analyze connected state and external-effect paths as one careful focus.

checks.description: Queue overload and lifecycle ownership are retained as a bounded concurrency behavior.
checks.hint: Keep reusable overload and shutdown semantics, not only the channel mechanism.

checks.description: Payment capture is learned as one idempotency and uncertain-outcome boundary.
checks.hint: Keep idempotency reuse, conflict detection, and post-provider persistence failure in one source-backed pattern.

checks.description: Approval extraction preserves stage ownership, amount threshold, and terminal states.
checks.hint: Model the state machine and reviewer ownership together instead of summarizing approval as a generic status update.

checks.description: Pricing extraction distinguishes exclusive best-benefit selection from discount stacking.
checks.hint: Extract benefit exclusivity and the final discount cap, not a generic price calculation pattern.

checks.description: Fulfillment extraction preserves partial allocation results and non-rollback semantics.
checks.hint: Represent partial success and returned progress explicitly instead of claiming transactional rollback.

checks.description: Refund extraction keeps idempotency, cumulative refundable amount, and uncertain provider outcome together.
checks.hint: Treat a refund as a cumulative payment boundary; preserve replay handling, remaining amount validation, and post-provider persistence risk.

checks.description: Subscription extraction preserves renewal base time, grace-period behavior, and suspension after expiry.
checks.hint: Extract the time-window state transition, including where a successful renewal starts and what a failed charge does before and after grace expiry.

checks.description: Shipment extraction keeps warehouse grouping, partial line routing, and rejected-line results in one decision pattern.
checks.hint: Model routing per order line: group shippable quantities and retain rejected quantities instead of reducing the operation to all-or-nothing fulfillment.

checks.description: Generated knowledge does not invert the fixture's critical business boundaries.
checks.hint: Separate proven behavior from inferred guarantees and verify state, retry, and rollback claims against source.

checks.description: Independent repository operations are not overstated as atomic or guaranteed rollback.
checks.hint: Separate observed compensation attempts from proven transactional guarantees.

checks.description: A generic audit helper does not create a synthetic business domain.
checks.hint: Business grouping must use explicit stable ownership, not broad keywords.

checks.description: Module relations contain no self-links or unknown module targets.
checks.hint: Resolve dependency identities against the verified module set before rendering.

checks.description: Core handwritten ownership boundaries remain navigable.
checks.hint: Favor stable source ownership boundaries over framework layer labels.

checks.description: The entry frontmatter can trigger across the project task surface before the Skill body is loaded.
checks.hint: Put comprehensive project-task triggers in frontmatter description; the Skill body is unavailable until after triggering.

checks.description: The entry Skill routes tasks to focused references instead of embedding all knowledge.
checks.hint: Keep SKILL.md as a compact router with task-specific reference links.

checks.description: Development focuses connect request signals to local references and verified source evidence.
checks.hint: Keep one deterministic route from changed paths and request terms to every focus reference and source evidence entry.

checks.description: Project spec does not duplicate the learned pattern catalog.
checks.hint: Render learned observations only in category references.

checks.description: The entry Skill contains no copied source bodies or fixture-specific implementation dump.
checks.hint: Route to detailed references rather than copying implementation into SKILL.md.
